The answer key was checked against Texas and NRC radiography rules (25 TAC §289.255, 10 CFR Part 34) and standard radiography data. Answers marked Medium involve a judgment call. The charts, meter faces, dosimeter scales, source-assembly drawing and bay diagram were redrawn for this quiz, because the originals were unreadable in the source video. The device drawings are photo stills. Words in [brackets] were unreadable in the source video and were filled in from context. Your exam will give you its own data sheet, so use its values.
